gds.description: Build and audit GOV.UK-compliant services: GOV.UK Design System components, patterns and styles, plus WCAG 2.2 AA accessibility and the public sector accessibility regulations.

shadcn.description: Build, audit, and preview modern web apps with shadcn/ui components on Radix UI primitives and Tailwind CSS, meeting WCAG 2.2 AA accessibility. The default design system for net-new SME and startup web apps.

mui.description: Build, audit, and preview Material Design interfaces in the app's own framework (Svelte SMUI/m3-svelte, React @mui/material): the shared Material system (colour, type, spacing, elevation, theming) and component inventory, plus WCAG 2.2 AA accessibility for consumer and general-purpose web apps.

carbon.description: Build and audit enterprise, data-heavy B2B interfaces with the IBM Carbon Design System: Carbon components (React and Web Components), patterns, IBM Design Language styles and tokens, plus WCAG 2.2 AA accessibility and an axe-based conformance baseline.

auth.description: The default auth pack: end-user sign-up and sign-in for a delivered app, backed by an Amazon Cognito user pool. Ships templated files (pool and public client, the API's token check and GET /api/me, the sign-in, sign-up, confirm-code and reset screens) that the platform renders into a new BYOA app's first commit, and a skill for what each build still writes. Self-sign-up is on by default; email verification is required.

docs.description: Author an app's documentation with three authoritative frameworks: Diátaxis (the four documentation modes), the C4 model (software architecture diagrams), and arc42 (the 12-section architecture template). The first-party required-documentation capability skills.

web-svelte.description: The web-framework plugin for SvelteKit: a static SPA build, file routing, the shell that hosts providers, the route guard and the nav, error, 404 and offline pages, a small API client, and the web side of the local run contract.

api-go.description: The api-runtime plugin: a Go HTTP server skeleton with request logging and correlation ids, a middleware chain, routes and paging, a health route, an OpenAPI contract and the local test issuer, behind the api.middleware and api.routes slots.

test-playwright.description: The test-harness plugin: a Playwright journey harness with a watched browser context, one sign-in for the suite and local test identities, fixtures that clean up after themselves, an axe WCAG 2.2 A/AA audit, and a read-only CI workflow.
